name: Diego Andres Ramirez
bio:
Diego's passion for motorsport began during his childhood in Santiago, where he spent countless hours tinkering with go-karts. He studied mechanical engineering at the Pontifical Catholic University of Chile, honing his technical skills and developing a keen eye for detail. After graduating, he worked briefly in the automotive industry before landing a role in a local racing team, where he quickly impressed with his ability to identify and resolve mechanical issues. 

Diego's approach to quality control is rigorous and uncompromising. He believes that even the smallest oversight can have significant consequences on the track. He is known for his methodical approach, his unwavering commitment to excellence, and his ability to remain calm under pressure. He is also a firm believer in continuous improvement, constantly seeking new ways to optimize processes and enhance performance. His focus on innovation and big picture thinking makes him a valuable asset to any team.

Driven by a desire to contribute to motorsport, he constantly refines his approach to quality control. He is respected for his work ethic and dedication to achieving consistent results, always pushing the boundaries of the team's performance.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight wave.
physical.description: Diego is of average height with a lean build and a focused expression.

quirks: Insists on using his own set of calibrated tools.
Always double-checks torque settings, even if someone else has already done it.
Drinks mate tea throughout the day, always prepared in a traditional gourd.
